scores.sentence: The hide and hair retain an ink-and-wash suggestion, but gray-beige wash and softened contour/detail separation fall short of the warm, strongly outlined person v2 references.
The front-facing figure retains restrained hide marks, but fuzzy fine boundaries and muted gray-beige planes lose the reference pair's crisp dark ink and amber wash.
The rear figure preserves selective hide folds and a lighter crown, but softened edges and near-monochrome gray hide lack the warm dark-contour separation of both person reference crops.
The rear figure reads as lightly washed hide with a crown highlight, yet blurred contour hierarchy and gray-beige values diverge from the bold warm person v2 reference pair.
The cloak has selective dark folds and quiet wash, but its pale gray-beige planes and softened outer contour lack the reference pair's clear ink hierarchy and ochre warmth.
The ochre hair approaches the reference warmth, while the cloak remains pale gray-beige and the softened contours and weak plane shading only partially match the person v2 reference pair.
